rationale: The Court is likely to extend Caterpillar’s remedial/finality logic, holding that § 1447(c)’s “before final judgment” language does not mandate post-judgment vacatur where the parties to the final judgment are completely diverse, and that any erroneous dismissal is addressed through ordinary appellate correction rather than automatic remand. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters pressing Finn/Grupo Dataflux and from one or more majority textualists to cabin the holding to the narrow “diversity at judgment” scenario.
